reference_sql:
WITH days AS (
  -- one row per day, 1 to 14 December 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS day
  FROM range(DATE '2025-12-01', DATE '2025-12-15', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
), daily AS (
  -- one row per UTC day with app events
  SELECT CAST(event_ts AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS events
  FROM app_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-15 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY CAST(event_ts AS DATE)
)
SELECT d.day, COALESCE(e.events, 0) AS events
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN daily e ON e.day = d.day

  SELECT CAST(generate_series AS DATE) AS day
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-12-01', DATE '2025-12-14', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
)
SELECT d.day, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_events e WHERE CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE) = d.day) AS events
FROM days d

WITH days AS (
  -- one row per day, 1 to 14 December 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS day
  FROM range(DATE '2025-12-01', DATE '2025-12-15', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
)
SELECT d.day, COUNT(e.event_id) AS events
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN app_events e ON CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE) = d.day
GROUP BY d.day

solver.query:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS day FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-12-01', DATE '2025-12-14', INTERVAL 1 DAY) t(d)
), e AS (
  SELECT CAST(event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS events
  FROM app_events
  WHERE (event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
    AND (event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-15 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.day, COALESCE(e.events, 0) AS events
FROM days d LEFT JOIN e ON e.day = d.day
